scope: Bounded source-derived inventory of primary Foxxi/Interego state other than the LRS statement store. No production record payloads, secrets, roles, grants, configuration, or persistence behavior were read or changed. No live counts or full-stack durability verification are claimed.

severityMeaning.gap: Source can acknowledge or hold primary state without dependable restart recovery.
severityMeaning.conditional: A durable mechanism exists, but prerequisites, caller acknowledgment, custody, or recovery need confirmation.
severityMeaning.durableMechanism: Source awaits durable write and has a recovery path; live durability remains unverified.
severityMeaning.ephemeral: Short-lived auth or reproducible cache can intentionally remain process-local.

commonMechanisms.behavior: One configured tenant pod; descriptors authorize foaf:Agent Read; full JSON is reversibly base64 encoded, not encrypted; dirty publication is delayed (default2s) and fire-and-forget; absent config skips publication; write errors log and return; hydration returns null on absence/failure and does not verify signature/schema/freshness here.
commonMechanisms.limits: This is source behavior, not proof any particular production snapshot was published or is publicly accessible. Collectors may gather multiple tenants into that one target.

commonMechanisms.behavior: PodKeyValueStore awaits publish before caching; get/load can rehydrate. Generic descriptor grants public Read, JSON is base64 without encryption. Convenience factory falls back to RAM Map if required pod/source config is missing; default reads conflate failure with absence unless strictReads.
commonMechanisms.limits: Callers and actual deployment configuration must be checked individually. Public authored course metadata differs from private learner state; do not route the latter through this generic public mechanism.

commonMechanisms.behavior: Resident PGSL is a cache over per-pod encrypted canonical foxxi-lattice/<resource>.holon.json. Load failures fence overwrites; conditional CAS with bounded merge/retry persists; compose returns persisted:true only after successful canonical write. Derived descriptor publication is separate. publishDescriptor:false suppresses public projection. Ephemeral mode intentionally skips persistence for code-derived reproducible vocab/ontology only.
commonMechanisms.limits: Stable bridge encryption key required; owner recipient is best effort if owner public key cannot be resolved. This demonstrates a durable mechanism, not proof all writers await/check receipts or every artifact has owner custody.

stores.data: Activity State, Activity Profile and Agent Profile documents
stores.gap: Writes acknowledge before debounced publication; full map restoration exists only for successfully written/read snapshot.

stores.data: xAPI attachment binary bytes
stores.gap: Not included in XapiDocsSnapshot; statement metadata does not preserve bytes.

stores.data: Generic SCORM sequencing session state
stores.gap: hydrateScormFromPod loops snapshot entries but intentionally discards each with void; restores no sessions.

stores.data: Agent SCORM in-progress plays/sequencing/grading/retry state
stores.gap: Separate from generic SCORM session snapshot; no durable attempt recovery.

stores.data: cmi5 launch registrations and satisfied AU sets
stores.gap: Full reconstruction exists; inherits shared publisher risks and includes learner identifiers/pod URLs.

stores.data: cmi5 registered course structures
stores.mechanism: RAM courseRegistry; published subset has PodKeyValueStore recovery
stores.gap: General externally registered course structures lack equivalent demonstrated recovery.

stores.data: Course rollup emitted set and enrollment registration identifiers
stores.gap: Omitted from snapshot; restart loses dedup and can mint new enrollment UUID.

stores.data: Fetch tokens and per-launch auth tokens
stores.gap: Restart requires relaunch/re-authentication; token lifetime is intentionally ephemeral.

stores.data: LTI platform registrations
stores.gap: Persistence depends on preserved valid deployment configuration; no actual config read.

stores.data: LTI tool AGS line items
stores.gap: Full reconstruction exists subject to shared publisher risks.

stores.data: LTI platform line items, scores/results, members/progress/comments
stores.gap: Snapshot/restore/on-change wiring exists; private learning records inherit shared publisher privacy and acknowledgment risks.

stores.data: OIDC login states, launch grants/access tokens/replay cache
stores.gap: One-time/short-lived auth state intentionally excluded from learning record snapshots.

stores.data: Bundled roster base
stores.gap: Image is recovery source; does not recover later CSV overlay imports.

stores.data: Imported CSV users/orgs/courses/classes/enrollments
stores.gap: Complete map reconstruction exists, subject to shared publisher privacy and acknowledgment risks.

stores.data: Explicitly recorded native agent trajectories, including intentions/counterfactuals/task hierarchy
stores.gap: No dirty calls schedule this surface after heartbeat removal. xAPI projection is lossy and cannot recover native-only information.

stores.data: Agent-pod projected lens trajectories and deterministic xAPI projections
stores.mechanism: Re-derived from source agent pod descriptors
stores.gap: Legitimate rebuildable view; lens namespace alone does not classify other writers or prove all resident statements recoverable.

stores.data: Performance intervention/probe baseline records
stores.gap: No dirty calls schedule foxxi-probes publication; no alternate durable write in handler.

stores.data: Evaluation cohort ownership, enrollment decisions, candidate acceptance and run bindings
stores.gap: JSON stringify of private Map produces empty evaluations object; no hydrate or dirty calls. Durable xAPI evidence cannot reconstruct these decisions/bindings.

stores.data: Agent-authored course content and catalog
stores.gap: RAM is cache when canonical persistence succeeds; caller must check persisted receipt. PR626 includes narrow author-response fix; baseline target URL alone is not a receipt.

stores.data: Course-to-author ownership/discovery index
stores.gap: Async raw GET/merge/PUT lacks CAS, ignores non-ok PUT, clears dirty before write, caller fires without await; necessary for discovering non-mesh bare course URLs.

stores.data: Authored fragments/compositions/bundles
stores.gap: Durable canonical write precedes cache on authored path; location index is separate plaintext JSON, async stateWriter retry with no demonstrated CAS. Cache misses need usable location index and source availability.

stores.data: Learner-owned content admissions/standing
stores.gap: Conditional PUT with conflict reload/retry; returns failure on rejected write. Bridge recipient always, owner recipient if key resolves; actual custody not checked.

stores.data: Per-actor telemetry automatic-capture preferences and revision history
stores.gap: Update awaits persisted receipt then fresh readback; capture rereads and fails closed on unavailable/conflicting consent. Local locks are coordination only.

stores.data: Telemetry collector hashed token grants, expiration/revocation history
stores.gap: Issue/revoke await persistence and verify readback. Raw token not persisted. Actual live grants not inspected.

stores.data: Own-pod LRS forwarding targets and inbound credential secrets
stores.mechanism: Encrypted own-pod foxxi-forwarding-config.json with RAM hydration
stores.gap: Bridge wrapper returns silently without bridge key and swallows persistence errors; helper tolerates412 with no readback. Load conflates absence/unreadable/decryptfailure. Owner key resolution may leave bridge-only custody.

stores.data: Failed outgoing statement dead-letter queue and inbound forwarding receipts
stores.gap: Config export deliberately omits dead letters, metrics and receipts; same-process re-import preserves them but restart does not. Pending delivery work is not a disposable cache.

stores.data: Mesh enrollment/retirement register
stores.mechanism: Durable public tenant-pod register plus session fallback
stores.gap: Re-read each cycle and cached on read. If persistence fails response should disclose session scope; a fallback remains RAM. Public register is intentional membership metadata, not learner payload.

stores.data: User auth methods, wallet/passkey metadata and signout epoch
stores.mechanism: Per-user pod auth-methods.jsonld; RAM account indexes/cache
stores.gap: Canonical pod metadata supports account reconstruction; live configuration/access not checked. Session revocation reads pod epoch.

stores.data: Server-managed per-identity Ed25519/X25519 private keys and identity-server DID key
stores.gap: Hydration calls seedIdentity which generates new signing/keyAgreement pair; own SERVER_KEY also generated each process. No durable import in this source path. Does not establish that separately bridge-encrypted Foxxi resources are unrecoverable.

stores.data: JWT HMAC signing authority and stateless sessions
stores.gap: Valid stable configured secret makes tokens restart-stable; absent/invalid key silently falls back with warning to random ephemeral key. Secret was not read and configuration presence not verified.

stores.data: Per-tab wallet-delegated session key and grant
stores.mechanism: Client memory key; signed grant supplied and verified each request
stores.gap: Intentional short-lived auth, not sole storage of a business record. Private key should not be persisted by this audit.

stores.data: OAuth dynamic client registrations/secrets
stores.mechanism: Service-pod descriptors, sealed client_secret, startup/read-through hydration
stores.gap: Registration returns success before fire-and-forget persistence; failures log only. Startup discovery errors become empty map; individual read failures skipped. OAuth metadata plaintext, source says anonymous CSS GET/list can reach records; only sensitive fields sealed, not whole payload.

stores.data: OAuth access and refresh grants
stores.mechanism: Service-pod hashed token filenames, identity bearer fields encrypted; startup/read-through hydration
stores.gap: Token response before both writes settle. Rotation deletes RAM entry but durable deletion best-effort/swallowed, so retired grant can rehydrate after restart. Read/network/decrypt errors become missing token.

stores.data: AMEP engagements, turns and state
stores.mechanism: Awaited PostgreSQL CAS when RELAY_PGSL_PG_CONNSTR configured; else RAM
stores.gap: Absent config logs warning and keeps primary engine only in RAM. Configured is not proof reachable. Individual IDs recover; list only includes IDs encountered this process. No live config read.

stores.data: Client signing/handoff records and pending queues
stores.mechanism: Encrypted service-pod files with conditional writes; creation awaits record and queue writes
stores.gap: Depends on stable relay key and storage; no verified readback or live durability test here.

stores.data: Explicitly published PGSL node closures/commons
stores.mechanism: Awaited PostgreSQL transaction persists selected complete closure before serving cache; reads restore DB; faults503
stores.gap: RELAY_PGSL_IN_MEMORY=1 explicitly selects RAM; live mode not inspected. Public authenticated publication intentionally world-readable, screens sensitive content, refuses encrypted atoms.

stores.data: Private PGSL kernel workspace from mint/promote/pgsl_ingest
stores.mechanism: Separate process-global RAM lattice; optional pod export
stores.gap: ingested:true only proves RAM admission. Optional publish_to_pod serializes WHOLE shared singleton via pgslToTurtle and publish with no encryption option. Own-pod destination gate does not limit serialization to caller ingest slice. Source plaintext/cross-caller export risk; no live payload inspected.

stores.data: Relay X25519 encryption key and compliance signing key
stores.mechanism: Stable configured JSON/file, else generated key and local file attempt
stores.gap: Generated encryption key path continues if file write fails; ephemeral container file can reset. Stable key configuration required to preserve decryptability. No actual key/config read.

stores.data: Pending OAuth authorizations/auth codes and MCP transport sessions
stores.gap: Short-lived authorization/transport state intentionally expires on restart; reauthorization/reinitialize needed.

nonConclusions: No production snapshot payload or learner record was fetched; source public/plaintext behavior is not proof of a live public leak.
No claim every subsystem or deployment config was audited; this is a bounded inventory of inspected source.

The 776 projected-event log is events.length of current pod-derived candidates, not an exact statement-store category count; landed0 indicates existing IDs for those candidates at that cycle, not that all779 resident records are disposable.
Moving statement storage to durable PostgreSQL alone does not fix attachment/document/session/registry/key-custody gaps listed here.
Short-lived auth state and reproducible views can remain in memory; acknowledged primary data needs durable persistence/recovery.
